scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Finite complete integer enumerations certify dimensions 2, 3 and 4; a fully written product-variance induction establishes all higher dimensions. The result assumes uniform vertex mass, a single deleted unweighted cube edge and real quadratic variance. Unindexed equivalent literature has not been excluded; external independent audit has not been performed.
title: A four-dimensional edge-fault threshold for sharp hypercube Lipschitz spread
